name: Montgomery County, MD
findings: Montgomery County has 5,658 nonprofit organizations. 2,376 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,984 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Montgomery County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
